job.question: In the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) RFP for an alternatives consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
job.expected_facts: At least seven (7) years providing general consulting services plus private equity consulting services, or alternatives consulting services only (all minimum qualifications must be met as of November 8, 2024, 3:00 p.m. EDT).
job.acceptance: Seven years is sufficient for the narrow question. Service type and qualification deadline are optional; five-year staff experience is not the firm threshold.

reviews.reason: This is a Massachusetts PRIM RFP for active global core equity investment management, not the BCERS alternatives-consultant RFP. Its three-year firm requirement does not support the BCERS firm-in-business threshold; its seven-year references concern record retention.
quotes: The Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board (“PRIM”) is soliciting responses from firms interested in providing Active Global Core Equity Investment Management Services.
The responding firm must have been continuously operating as an investment management organization for at least three years as of June 30, 2026.

With respect to the Account, the Manager shall keep accurate books and records relating to its transactions for the Account for a period of no less than seven (7) years following the termination of this Agreement.
